title: Trump Suggests Injecting Disinfectant Into The Body To Treat Coronavirus | MSNBC
summary: MSNBC's clip of the April 2020 White House coronavirus briefing in which President Trump responds to a DHS presentation on disinfectants by musing about injecting disinfectant into the body. The segment is three minutes long.
why: Used as primary footage when commenters need to check exactly what was said, in threads on COVID misinformation and trusting authorities.

quote.text: You can literally watch him come up with the idea all on his own in real time.
